corpus.selection: Topics outside the 47 gold-set documents so the gate stays a held-out test. A first pick included bert, resnet and vit, which are gold papers; caught before any data was generated and replaced by word2vec (1301.3781), bahdanau-attention (1409.0473) and chinchilla (2203.15556).

index.stack: mineru-eg2-faiss (MinerU 3.4.5 pipeline backend, embeddinggemma-2 Q8_0 512-dim via llama-server b11669 on CPU, FAISS)
index.path: run_eval.ensure_indexed, the gate's own indexing path, contextual retrieval off as in the gate
index.note: Embedder on CPU so MinerU kept the GPU; about 70 min for 26 documents.

questions.acceptance: answer is a verbatim span of the chunk (whitespace-normalised), <= 60 chars, question ends with '?'; translated questions (en doc, es/ca question) only when the answer has a digit

rubric.findings: 4.4% degenerate references (answer echoed in question), ~42 bibliography questions, 20 references behind a non-breaking space, ~209 chunks with digit-spaced numbers

rules.answer_echoed_in_question: normalised reference is a substring of the question
rules.bibliography_chunk: >= 3 citation markers (ISBN, doi, pp., vol., Retrieved, Consultado, Consultat, Archived...) in the chunk

distill.note: retrieve ~25 min, teacher ~60 min on RTX 4060 Laptop

judge_audit.pattern: judge marks faithful for unsupported asides that do not touch the answer (d0216,d0148,d0212): stricter than rubric; bad items kept discarded (conservative)

gate:sft-r32.finding: SFT on short factual answers only: +6 factual (ca +8) but study modes (outline/summary/quiz) 10/12 -> 4/12: structured-output forgetting

synth_audit_opus.note: Haiku errs strict: drops valid items for reasons outside its criteria (bibliography rule, added year); never kept a wrong item
